name: Equilateral Edge Length Regularization
definition: A regularization term that penalizes the variance of edge lengths on the extracted mesh to generate equilateral triangles, useful for physics simulation.
summary: Equilateral Edge Length Regularization is a mesh post-processing technique that penalizes edge length variance to encourage equilateral triangles, uniquely suited for flexible representations like FlexiCubes to avoid the geometric degradation seen in rigid methods.
